issue.title: Repair published bead-page commit links that bare-label non-primary repos
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-e8.6 (epic sase-e8) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; verified independently by the sase-e8 land agent and NOT caused by that epic.

`sase doctor -C project.bead_pages -j` reports ERROR: '5 published commit link(s) misattributed to the primary repository', next step 'Run `sase bead pages refresh --write`.'. The five findings span two unrelated lineages, both predating epic sase-e8:

- sase/repos/beads/pages/sase-b5/README.md: `218e78c` and `4905691` link to https://github.com/sase-org/sase--plans/commit/...
- sase/repos/beads/pages/sase-b5/sase-b5.1.md: `218e78c` links to the same sase--plans commit
- sase/repos/beads/pages/sase-b7/README.md and sase-b7/sase-b7.1.md: `ee287b0` links to https://github.com/sase-org/sase-core/commit/...

The URLs are right and the labels are wrong. I confirmed each commit really does live in the repo its URL names: `git log -1 ee287b0` resolves in the sase-core linked checkout ('feat!: materialize VCS-backed artifact files') and fails in the primary sase checkout, and `218e78c` resolves in the plans sidecar ('docs: add missing prompt backlinks') and fails in the primary. Per the invariant documented in _check_bead_page_commit_links (src/sase/doctor/checks_beads.py:65) a bare short-SHA label claims the primary repository, so a bare label whose href points at a sidecar or linked remote is a rendering defect: the label should be repo-qualified.

Scope: decide whether the projection that writes published pages still bare-labels non-primary commits (fix it if so) or whether these pages are merely stale bytes from an older projection, then republish the affected pages so `sase doctor` returns OK. Note the recommended remedy writes to the shared beads sidecar repo, which is an outward-facing publish; the sase-e8 land agent deliberately left that to the project owner.

payload.close_reason: Backlog triage 2026-08-05 at master 0e40decdc. Each of these was re-verified as STILL REPRODUCING and is being closed as a deliberate deprioritization, not as fixed: sase-ed ('sase doctor -C project.bead_pages' still reports the same 5 misattributed commit links across sase-b5 and sase-b7 pages); sase-er (src/sase/main/bead_fast_path.py:9 still imports close_mutation_commit_message and mutation_commit_message at module scope); sase-es (src/sase/main/parser.py:461 still pulls COMMAND_REGISTRARS_BY_NAME from parser_full_registrars); sase-ev (crates/sase_core/src/bead/cli.rs:172 handle_show is still the dormant parity renderer); sase-ey (src/sase/bead/cli_detail.py still prints raw closed_at and src/sase/agents/cli_sync.py:152 still hardcodes a UTC strftime label); sase-f7 ('sase agent index verify -j' still ok=false with corrupt_rows=4, and missing_rows has grown from 2 to 77); sase-f9 ('sase bead doctor' still reports the same 14 malformed design refs, 14 sase-5l.* owner mismatches, 1 unresolvable artifact ref, and now 453 redundant close events). The project owner capped the reviewable task backlog at five and these did not make the cut. All scope and evidence stays readable here, and a +1 with fresh evidence reopens any of them automatically.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction on 2026-08-08 at sase master 3c771b77c, workspace sase_10, clean tree. 'sase doctor' still reports ERROR project.bead_pages '5 published commit link(s) misattributed to the primary repository'. The --json data.misattributed payload is byte-identical to the original five findings: sase-b5/README.md labels 218e78c and 4905691 pointing at github.com/sase-org/sase--plans, sase-b5/sase-b5.1.md label 218e78c pointing at the same sase--plans commit, and sase-b7/README.md plus sase-b7/sase-b7.1.md label ee287b0 pointing at github.com/sase-org/sase-core. No new lineages have joined the set in the 3 days since the 2026-08-05 triage re-verification, so the projection is not actively producing new bare labels — these are stale published bytes. Impact today: project.bead_pages is the only ERROR-status doctor check in a clean workspace, so 'sase doctor' ends red for every agent and trains them to ignore it; two sase-hf phase agents (sase-hf.4 and sase-hf.5) independently flagged it as unrelated noise while landing that epic. Reported by the sase-hf land agent on behalf of PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes from sase-hf.4 and sase-hf.5.

payload.entry: Updated the four affected published bead pages in the beads sidecar so the five non-primary commit links use repo-qualified labels (sase--plans@218e78c, sase--plans@4905691, sase-core@ee287b0). Verified 'sase doctor -C project.bead_pages -j' now reports status OK with 0 misattributed links; also verified no bare 218e78c/4905691/ee287b0 Markdown commit labels remain under pages/sase-b5 or pages/sase-b7. No commits were created.
